newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ARCON awards tranport contract to local firm.
newsitem.headline: ARCON awards tranport contract to local firm.

text.p: Irish exploration group ARCON International Resources Plc said on Thursday it had awarded a 3.5-million-punt transport contract to Kilkenny-based Coolwagon Ltd.

The contract, for transportation of mineral concentrates from ARCON's lead-zinc mine at Galmoy in the Irish midlands, is worth more than 750,000 punts per year over the next five years, ARCON said in a statement.
It added that the awarding of the tranport contract marked another important step by ARCON in its preparations for commencing full production at Galmoy by the beginning of 1997.
